title: Coins and Money: Identify, Count and Add
description: Identify pennies, nickels, dimes, and quarters, then count, add, and solve introductory coin problems within 100 cents.
learningFocus: Identify pennies, nickels, dimes, and quarters by name and value.
Count and add same and mixed coins within 100 cents using skip-counting and addition strategies.
Solve simple money situations as introductory Grade 1 practice that prepares for Grade 2 standard 2.MD.C.8; money is not presented as a Grade 1 standard.
adultGuidance: Coins are worth different amounts, and the smallest coin is not worth the least. Say each coin's name and value together, then count from the biggest value down: quarters, dimes, nickels, pennies. Let your child handle real coins and count aloud by 5s, 10s, and 25s. If a total is tricky, count the coins again slowly, one at a time.
